botSpecification.name: NiftySensex_Weekly_Options_Buyer_Bot
botSpecification.description: Professional directional options buying bot for NIFTY 50 and SENSEX. Combines options chain OI intelligence, quantitative chart analysis (no visual/image processing), Greeks-free proxies for theta/gamma, and optional debit-spread hedging. Special emphasis on weekly expiries with strict time-decay protection.

quantitativeChartAnalysis.description: Replaces all visual chart reading with numerical rules on OHLCV candle data (5min and 15min timeframes). Bot fetches raw candles via broker API and applies rules.

spotChartRules.trendDetection: EMA9 > EMA21 = bullish bias; EMA9 < EMA21 = bearish bias
spotChartRules.swingTrend: Detect higher highs & higher lows (bullish) or lower highs & lower lows (bearish) over last 5-10 swings
spotChartRules.supportResistance: Use recent swing highs/lows OR high-OI strikes from chain as dynamic levels
spotChartRules.breakoutConfirmation: Price crosses resistance/support + volume > 1.5 * 20-period average volume = strong signal
spotChartRules.oiLevelIntegration: Mark top-3 Call OI strikes as resistance and top-3 Put OI strikes as support

optionPremiumChartRules.gammaProxy: abs((premium_pct_change / spot_pct_change)) > 0.6 → high gamma (fast reaction preferred)
optionPremiumChartRules.thetaDecayProxy: spot_change_last_5_candles < 0.002 AND premium_change_last_5_candles < -0.01 → decay active (warning or exit)
optionPremiumChartRules.momentumCheck: Premium making higher highs while spot is flat or rising = positive confirmation

quantitativeChartAnalysis.combinedSignalWeight: At least 3 out of 4 chart rules must align with OI bias before generating entry signal

dataRequirements.newsSentiment: optional (keyword scan or external API for bullish/bearish cues)

chainAnalysis.focusZoneRule: ATM strike + exactly 3 strikes above + 3 strikes below

keySignals.supportZone: Highest Put OI cluster in the lower 3 strikes (put writers defending)
keySignals.resistanceZone: Highest Call OI cluster in the upper 3 strikes (call writers defending)

chainAnalysis.maxPainAlignment: Price likely to gravitate toward max pain by expiry — use as additional filter

greeksProxies.ivRuleForBuyers: prefer_iv_percentile_lt_50 (buy when volatility is relatively cheap)

debitSpread.bullCallSpread: Buy ATM_or_slightly_OTM_CE + Sell higher_OTM_CE (1-2 strikes above)
debitSpread.bearPutSpread: Buy ATM_or_slightly_OTM_PE + Sell lower_OTM_PE (1-2 strikes below)

dailyWorkflow: 09:00_AM: Fetch spot price + full options chain for next weekly expiry
Run OI, Change in OI, PCR, Max Pain analysis
Fetch 5min/15min OHLCV for spot and run quantitative chart rules
Check DTE, IV percentile, decay/gamma proxies
Generate signal: Bullish (Call), Bearish (Put), or Flat
Decide naked vs debit spread mode
Calculate position size and place broker order if conditions met
Monitor live candles + premium charts and apply exit rules automatically
